name: t13-read-v5
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 27 Oct night; ideas from Matteo's observed-growth-v10 (branch matteo/main): best value at the level, two-month review window, repair at once
hypothesis: In three official t13-read-v2 games DeepSeek never filled the Stalled field (0 of 160 notes), lost a promotion to an Output cost taken in the review month (optional extra work for others), and spent the quarter before a review on risk clean-up with a friendly HR remark instead of building a margin. Filling the three stats in the quarter right before a review, staying on own delivery when the review is close, and a Skill-first quarter from L4 (the t13-final line, which DeepSeek obeys) should keep more promotions and reach higher levels.
predicted_behaviour: Promotion at most reviews up to L4, Skill-first quarters from L4, no rise in trust crises.
refutation: Missed promotions at the same rate as t13-read-v2 in official games, or more trust crises.
